Capability graph projects maintained and observed provenance separately, retains complete comparison endpoints and historical floors/targets, qualifies only explicitly related exact selected work evidence through scoped readiness, and preserves unknown runtime impact and semantic freshness without execution or writes.
acceptance: Read-only audit reports execution controls not-evaluated and does not invoke configured commands; executed audit records failures and prevents higher cumulative levels.

Accepted proof-evidence rejects failed, stale or unreviewed selected attempts under current policy; protected audit rejects missing or drifting external baseline/command context before effects.
